data.define: Used when you're thrilled about something.

misuse.text: Don't say 'stoked' in a formal speech.

hook.text: Road trip with my friends tomorrow!

publish.title: What does "stoked" mean?
publish.value: Stoked = Very happy and excited. Example: "I'm stoked about the trip!" (very casual English, US).
